caption: The drawing depicts an ornate wooden confessional booth, predominantly painted in cream or light beige tones with darker brown shading to accentuate depth and detail. The booth consists of two main sections—a taller back panel and a lower front enclosure. The back panel is arched with an intricately carved top, crowned by a cross at the center and decorative finials at each corner. The vertical surfaces of the booth are segmented into rectangular and oval panels, each adorned with elaborate gold and bronze-colored designs and motifs. Some panels contain maroon or reddish insets, adding contrast to the cream base color. The booth is positioned slightly angled to show both the front and a side, displaying detailed carvings and ornamental features on all visible surfaces. There is a small alcove within the upper section of the back panel, framed by two small columns and a shell-like arch. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white, and unadorned, ensuring the focus remains on the booth itself. There is a small inscription in the lower right corner that provides additional information about the object.
title: Side of Confessional
